name: Before the Fall
description: Once a battle, it names the foe's strongest move. The first critical hit against its side each battle is an ordinary hit.

name: Rope-a-Dope
description: Each time it is hit by a contact move, its next attack gains 10% power, up to 20%.

name: Foster Wing
description: Once a battle, when it is sent in for an ally that left with less than half its HP, its Defense rises by one stage.

name: House Call
description: Once a battle, on entry, a plain Rotom takes the appliance form that suits the foe best, and keeps it until it faints or the battle ends.
